0022600142.text: The Dallas Mavericks (2-2, 3rd in the Southwest and 2 games back, 7th in the West) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (4-0, 1st in the Northwest and 1st in the West, on a four-game win streak) in Dallas's fifth game of the season. Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Naji Marshall (illness) and Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee), with Alex Caruso (ankle) day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Mavericks lost the season series 0-3, most recently 100-87 in Dallas on March 1, 2026.
